you realise that it is of Santa and Nymph as they founded 
the clan, having their first members go through their
baptism of fire. Ever since that day, every Storm Dragon 
raised above the rank of Wyrm goes through the same ritual,
invoking the arcane powers of Glaurung, the father of all
dragons, making them in to powerful and respected beings.

Rooms.Name: The First Nexus
Rooms.Description:
You are floating at the centre of a large intersection. Exits 
lead in all directions, the horizontal ones through large portals
filled with a shimmering light. The spaces between them are filled
with more detailed and intricate murals depicting the clan history.

Exits.Description: A red shimmering light fills the arch to the north of you.
A green shimmering light fills the arch to the east.
A black void greets you to the south.
The portal to the west is covered in a yellow forcefield.
The main shaft of the fortress stretches up above you.
It's a long way down!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see dragons of all shapes, kinds, colours and sizes 
streaming towards a giant building sculpted into the living
rock of an enormous mountain. The Storm Dragons Clan House!
A massive dragon hangs in the air over the clan house, 
golden light flowing from its every pore, Glaurung, father 
of dragonkind, blesses the rapidly swelling ranks of the Storm 
Dragons. Waiting at the doors to welcome the worthy and pure 
of heart stand Evil and Nymph.

Rooms.Name: The Second Nexus
Rooms.Description:
You are floating at another cross-roads in the Storm Dragons'
fortress. The walls are richly decorated with scenes from the
clans colourfully past. These one however, are tinged with darkness
and gloom. Around you four massive doorways filled with a shimmering
silver light which prevents you from looking through lead in north,
south, east and west. You can also try up or down the fortress' main
thoroughfare.

Exits.Description: A silver forcefield lies to the north.
A silver forcefield lies to the east.
A silver forcefield lies to the south.
A silver forcefield lies to the west.
The fortress continues to rise above you.
The warm and pleasant draft from the volcano blows up at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Strife and its followers death and destruction shroud these pictures in
darkness. You see thunderclouds over the clan house, dragon fighting
dragon, alien beings massing to strike in this moment of darkness. And 
in the background an exodus, as dragons sick of the internecine 
wrangling leave the clan forever to make a new start, somewhere out 
there, in a better place.

Rooms.Name: The Third Nexus
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at one of the higher junctions in the Storm 
Dragons' fortress. Huge portals filled with gold shimmering force
fields lie to the north, east, south and west. Recent scenes from 
the clan's long history bedeck the walls in this wide shaft. Above
you you can see the shaft end as it expands into an enormous hall
Below you the shaft disappears in to the distance, vanishing to 
a tiny dot.

Exits.Description: A magnificent archway radiating golden light lies to the north.
A magnificent archway radiating golden light lies to the east.
A magnificent archway radiating golden light lies to the south.
A magnificent archway radiating golden light lies to the west.
Not far above you the shaft abruptly enters a huge cavernous hall.
As you look down the shaft disappears to a point in the distance.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The focal point of these pictures is the clan house, run down 
and falling into decay. But all around the room a procession 
of dragons marches towards the gates of the building. At their
head flies a black dragon, blood dripping from his fangs as 
the long lost Zharradan returns to rebuild the clan to its 
former glory. In the background you see a smoking volcano 
and through the smoke and haze you see the fortress, retreat
and citadel of the Storm Dragons constructed to preserve the
life and ideals of the clans through dark, hard times.

Rooms.Name: The Dragons' Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are stunned. The central shaft opens and spreads to the west
into a huge hall. You eyes are drawn due west to where the Thrones
sit. You marvel at the colossal nature of the very place itself, then
you notice something odd about the thrones. They shift and shimmer
before your eyes blurring seamlessly from form to form. You can not
make out any more than that at this distance. To the north, east and
south massive, ornately decorated, arches lead to the private chambers
of the clan leaders. High above you on an enormous balcony which
circles the hall you see massive statues staring down at you, peering
deep inside your soul.

Exits.Description:
Through the decorous archway comes nothing but raw blackness. Sucking
in all light and pulling at the very essence of your lifeforce. The
mighty Vampire Dragonlord Zharradan welcomes you to his domain with a
smile.
A pair of massive grey stone doors fill the archway to the east.

A forcefield similar to others seen around the fortress blocks your
view through the southern archway.

You look with curiosity towards the throne room of the Storm Dragons.
The thrones seem to be arranged in a parabola, with the opening towards
you.

A yellow cylindrical forcefield continues to map out a path up into
the heavens.
The shaft disappears, straight down, as far as you can see.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can't see much from here. They do, however, appear to be changing
shape. An experience you can only imagine to be rather peculiar to the
user!

Rooms.Name: The Council of the Immortals
Rooms.Description:
You are now at 'eye' level with the Clan Immortals. Their statues
surround you on all sides. To reach then you can try north, east, south
or west. However, you will have to leave the support of the warm draft
from the volcano to do so. Above you the roof comes to a point where
the force field goes up into the 'neck' of the dragon. Beneath you lies
the Throne Room of the fortress, spread out in all its magnificence.

Exits.Description: Statues stare at you balefully from the north.
Statues stare at you balefully from the east.
Statues stare at you balefully from the south.
Statues stare at you balefully from the west.

The current of air disappears into a hole in the ceiling at the start
of the neck of the fortress.

You can see the Throne room and the rooms of the clan leaders dwellings
below you.

Rooms.Description:
You are travelling in the Dragon's neck. You are surrounded by rock
carved in intricate patterns. Beneath you through a small hole comes
a great flood of light. Above you the neck continues to narrow as you
presume it nears the head and your way out of the fortress.

Exits.Description: The neck narrows above you.

You can see a small portion of the throne room of the Storm Dragon
fortress though a hole in its roof.

Rooms.Name: Before Glaurung
Rooms.Description:
The neck of the Storm Dragon's fortress has narrowed here and you
have reached the base of the jaw. The air from the volcano far, far
below you, now howls around you as it is forced through this small path.
You can feel a powerful presence coming from just above you. Warm and
kind, yet powerful and implacable in the defence of its kind. Just
above you you see serrated teeth, perhaps just a little too much
attention to detail in the fortress for your liking. A strange glow
comes from somewhere above. Beneath you the neck stretches into the
distance.

Exits.Description:
You are just below the mouth of the dragon, complete with teeth and
an eerie glow.
The neck dwindles to a tiny point of light far below you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A yellow light pulses slowly, reflected from the rocky walls of the
fortress

Rooms.Name: In the Mouth of Glaurung
Rooms.Description:
Rows of razor sharp teeth line the inside of the mouth. You never
realised that dragons had six rows of the things! The mouth is long and
narrow and ends just above you. You can see light from the outside
world at its end. The force holding you up is weakening now and you
know that you are almost free of the fortress. A yellow glow is
coming for a small hole in the roof of the mouth to the west of here.

Exits.Description:
The hole is about big enough for a dragon to just squeeze through if
they really tried. A pulsating yellow light emanates from it along
with a presence so powerful you can almost touch it.
You can see a way out of the fortress just above you!
You can battle your way against the updraft down into the neck.

Rooms.Name: End of a Lava Flow to the South of the Volcano.
Rooms.Description:
A huge, glass like slide of molten rock has solidified here. Time
and eruptions have caused it to split and shatter into razor sharp
shards and it is quite unclimbable. The path continues through the rocks
to the east and west. Above you the volcano continues to belch smoke
and ash in to the air.

Exits.Description: A small trail rapidly disappears through the boulders to the east.
A small path winds through the jagged rocks to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The huge bulk of a volcano towers over you to the north. As you look
up the slope whisps of smoke from the cloud pouring forth high above
you catch at your throat and make you cough.

Rooms.Name: Mob Chute 1 - target volcano
Rooms.Description: If you can see this, we're in trouble.

Rooms.Name: Mob Chute 2 - target fortress
Rooms.Description: If you can see this then we are in trouble!

Mobs.Name: adventurer sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Adventurer is here seeking his fortune.
Mobs.Description:
The Adventurer is a hardy soul, toughened by years of rough and tumble.
He is clothed in the simple leggings and tunic of a humble man, sensible
wear for an outdoor life.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote pauses in his quest for glory, whips out a grubby flannel and wipes his face.

Mobs.Name: squire sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Squire stands patiently waiting for his Master to call.
Mobs.Description:
The Knight's Squire, resplendent in his red and green uniform, stands 
ready to assist his master. A young human he is in the bloom of good
health and as a special sign of recognition has been allowed to carry
his own sword on this dangerous mission.

Mobs.Name: wyvern sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Wyvern lunges at you with vicious claws extended.
Mobs.Description:
The Wyvern is a distant relative of the mighty Dragon. Smaller and 
without great intelligence it has nevertheless survived since the 
wyverns were driven from their home near the mountains of Moria by 
Divine Will. The journey has hardened it beyond all recognition and 
numerous scars across its scales are testament to its survival 
abilities. You wonder if it may have been mistaken for a dragon!

Mobs.Name: knight sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Knight stands here, shining in his armour.
Mobs.Description:
The Knight is a powerful human aged about thirty years old. His eyes 
shine with the glazed expression of a man pursuing a holy war. His 
task, to rid the land of dragons! His armour and sword are new and 
shiny and you suspect that he has yet to meet his first dragon.

Mobs.Name: lion sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Mountain Lion eyes you hungrily.
Mobs.Description:
The Mountain Lion is more of a great cat rather than a true lion. It 
is thin and hungry and covered in short brown fur. Yellow eyes blaze 
at you from its short flat face and powerful legs are tipped with razor
sharp claws poised to rip you to shreds.

Mobs.Name: snake giant sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Giant Snake slithers towards you across the ground.
Mobs.Description:
The huge brown snake is thicker than a man's thigh and very long. It 
is slowly and smoothly gliding towards you over the ground.

Mobs.Name: champion knight sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The King's Champion stands here praying for guidence.
Mobs.Description:
A veritable powerhouse of a man, the King's Champion is dressed in 
expensive and well maintained armour. His robes and finery are offset 
by his hardened, battle-scarred face. His gaze is steely and merciless 
and he has you at its focus.

Mobs.Name: salamander giant sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Salamander rears up and pours forth fire!
Mobs.Description:
The Salamander is a creature of heat and fire with a human torso and a 
reptilian lower half. Its gold eyes are sunk deep into its head which 
is topped with wild black hair. Its skin is red and the scales on its 
tail fade from red to orange at its tip.

Mobs.Name: egg dragon sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: An Egg sits here waiting to hatch.
Mobs.Description:
The size of a small boulder the egg's surface is smooth but mottled with 
many colours. It rocks slightly from time to time and you surmise that 
a dragon is about to hatch from it.

Mobs.Name: hatchling sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Hatchling flaps about practising with its wings.
Mobs.Description:
The Hatchling is a rather large but nonetheless, baby, dragon. It is 
flapping its wings experimentally and hopping about on its already 
sturdy and powerful legs. Its scales have hardened in the hours after
its hatching and it is already well protected. As it peers at you it 
seems more curious about you than afraid or aggressive.

Mobs.Name: YoungWyrm young wyrm sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Young Wyrm eyes you thoughtfully.
Mobs.Description:
The Young Wyrm has the fully developed body of a dragon and has mastered
the art of flight and dextrous use of its limbs. Although only half grown
it is large and its otherwise grey colouration is beginning to lighten as
its adult hue starts to show through.

Mobs.Name: wyrm sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Wyrm is resting here.
Mobs.Description:
The Wyrm is a fully grown dragon. It really is very large indeed. It
has a long neck and tail, which give it excellent reach, and very sharp
claws. Its wings occasionally fan the air producing powerful blasts 
which threaten to knock you off your feet. This one has turned out a 
rather impressive gold colour and seems to shine with a gentle light.

Mobs.Name: ElderWyrm elder wyrm sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Elder Wyrm, conscious of his duty, stands here protecting his clan.
Mobs.Description:
The Elder Wyrm is a seasoned campaigner. Years of study and exercise in
the formative atmosphere of the Storm Dragon clan have produced a being
destined for greatness. Next in line for the ruling class he is happy
to serve his clan in the knowledge that elevation will come when he is
ready.

Mobs.Name: drake dragon sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Drake, master of all he sees stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The Drake, newly appointed to his position in the ruling classes,
stands tall and proud. As a dragon of particular worth and dedication,
he has reached enlightenment and is now one with the forefather,
Glaurung.

Mobs.Name: drake golden sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Huge Golden, Storm Dragon Drake, stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The Drake is a burnished gold colour, like that of a glorious sunset. He
is slimmer than the average dragon with a longer neck and tail than
usual. His teeth and claws however look perfectly normal for a dragon!

Mobs.Name: drake powerful sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Powerful Storm Dragon Drake, stands here.
Mobs.Description:
Quite short and squat for a dragon, the Drake still dwarfs most other
sentient beings he comes across. His scales are a steely grey series
of overlapping plates that are very hard to penetrate. His eyes are
bright green and occasionally the transparent inner eyelid blinks
enabling him to study you without ever taking his eyes from you.

Mobs.Name: GreatDrake great drake sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Great Drake of the Storm Dragons stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The Great Drake is a huge specimen of a dragon. Dark brown from its
serious looking mouth down to the tip of its long flexible tail the
only concession to colour are its yellow eyes. It scales look very
tough, its teeth and claws razor sharp. A very formidable killing
machine should it choose to turn on you.

Mobs.Name: greatdrake ancient great drake sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: An Ancient Great Drake and mighty warrior, stands here.
Mobs.Description:
Despite his enormous size the Great Drake hovers just above the ground. 
Famed for his fighting prowess he still has a few chipped and cracked 
scales from teaching enemies the power of the Storm Dragons. Armoured
like a tank and possessed of both physical and mental weapons of 
destruction he weaves an intricate pattern of light between his front
claws.

Mobs.Name: greatdrake mighty great drake sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Mighty Great Drake stands here.
Mobs.Description:
Huge and battle scarred, the scaly bulk of a Mighty Great Drake fills 
your view. His powerful body is covered in scales larger than a dinner 
plate and his equally well-armoured limbs are well placed to rend you 
limb from limb.

Mobs.Name: GrandDrake grand drake sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Storm Dragon Grand Drake stands here.
Mobs.Description:
The Grand Drake has almost reached the pinnacle of the Storm Dragon
clan. It is easy to see why. Wise but kindly eyes peer down at you
from the head of this enormous dragon. A beautiful silvery-gray sheen
ripples across the well muscled body as it moves.

Mobs.Name: avatar dragonlord granddrake grand drake sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Mighty Avatar Dragonlord stands here.
Mobs.Description:
You stand before a mighty avatar dragonlord. His eyes burn with fire as 
he looks impassively at you. He is dressed in shiny golden armour that 
blazes like the sun and in his had he holds a huge sword.

Mobs.Name: grand drake genial dragonlord GrandDrake sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Genial Avatar Dragonlord stands here.
Mobs.Description:
He has chosen to appear in avatar form today. A large glowing 
golden humanoid stands before you, tastefully attired in a plain white
robe and a large golden belt. Perched jauntily on his head sits the 
traditional pointed wizards hat! A neat fringe protrudes under the rim
neatly framing the grinning face below. Friendly, genial and extremely
deadly are impressions that his casual countenance convey!

Mobs.Name: HighDrake high drake dragonlord sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A High Drake and Dragonlord stands here.
Mobs.Description:
As a leader of the Storm Dragons the High Drake is respected and feared 
in all the lands. Wise and powerful, both physically and mentally, 
he takes a particularly strong role within the clan itself. Whereas 
some clan members further the clan mainly in the world outside,
this one also takes time to nurture the young and pass on his wisdom.

Mobs.Name: statue immortal god sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Statue of a Storm Dragon Immortal stands resolute here.
Mobs.Description:
A feeble replica of the might and glory of a Storm Dragon God has
been placed here to allow its namesake's spirit to permeate this
place.

Mobs.Name: attendant sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: An Attendant awaits the pleasure of a Storm Dragon.
Mobs.Description:
These attendants all look the same to you! Humanoid but strangely
silent they show no emotion as they move among the Storm Dragons.
Their grey sallow skin gleams oddly in the light and their eyes are
sunken, dark pools.

Mobs.Name: soul vanquished sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Vanquished Soul suffers here.
Mobs.Description:
A vanquished soul writhes in agony. An ephemeral, ghost like, outline
of a man it waxes and wanes with a slow pulsing rhythm. Barely audible
moans and cries of anguish seem to appear from nowhere around you.

Mobs.Name: bone beast sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Bone Beast rattles and clacks as it moves towards you!
Mobs.Description:
An strange assortment of bones, animated by hatred and suffering, are
lurching about unable to find eternal peace. It doesn't seem very 
interested in you. It's probably more concerned with it's own problems.

Mobs.Name: elf tortured sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Tortured Elf writhes in agony on the floor here.
Mobs.Description:
He seems to be in very bad condition and it doesn't look like he 
will last much longer. However, you notice that some of the cuts 
have been partially healed, as if Zharradan is keeping him alive 
and in pain for as long as possible...

Mobs.Name: elf tortured sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Tortured Elf writhes in agony on the floor here.
Mobs.Description:
She seems to be in very bad condition and it doesn't look like she 
will last much longer. However, you notice that some of the cuts 
have been partially healed, as if Zharradan is keeping her alive 
and in pain for as long as possible...

Mobs.Name: ElderWyrm elder wyrm sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Elder Wyrm, conscious of his duty, stands here protecting his clan.
Mobs.Description:
The Elder Wyrm is a seasoned campaigner. Years of study and exercise in
the formative atmosphere of the Storm Dragon clan have produced a being
destined for greatness. Next in line for the ruling class he is happy
to serve his clan in the knowledge that elevation will come when he is
ready.

Mobs.Name: drake dragonlady sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: A Dragonlady, one of the Storm Dragon Drakes, stands here.
Mobs.Description:
She is slightly larger than an average dragon and you realise that
female dragons have a slight size advantage over the males. She regards
you with a not unkindly air whilst retaining the ability to reduce you
to a bloody pulp, should she choose to do so.

Mobs.Name: hatchling messy sdzone
Mobs.LongDescription: The Hatchling flaps about practising with its wings.
Mobs.Description:
The Hatchling is a rather large but nonetheless, baby, dragon. It is 
flapping its wings experimentally and hoping about on its already 
sturdy and powerful legs. Its scales have hardened in the hours after
its hatching and it is already well protected. As it peers at you it 
seems more curious about you than afraid or aggressive.

Objects.Name: key garrion garrion's sdzone
Objects.Description: A simple key with a few teeth lies here.

Objects.Name: ring dragon drake
Objects.Description: An ornate ring in the shape of a dragon biting its tail.

Objects.Name: ring grand drake sdzone
Objects.Description: A ring in the shape of a dragon biting its tail.

Objects.Name: ring great drake sdzone
Objects.Description: An ornate ring in the shape of a dragon biting its tail.

Objects.Name: ring high drake sdzone
Objects.Description: An ornate ring in the shape of a dragon biting its tail.

Objects.Name: twig flaming sdzone
Objects.Description: A long twig burns brightly on the floor.

Objects.Name: rope climbing sdzone
Objects.Description: a neatly coiled climbing rope is lying on the floor.

Objects.Name: boots climbing sdzone
Objects.Description: A well-used but well cared-for pair of leather climbing boots, complete with crampons, are sitting here.

Objects.Name: bag kitbag scruffy sdzone
Objects.Description: A scruffy kitbag with a leather shoulder strap has been dumped on the floor here.

Objects.Name: rations iron food sdzone
Objects.Description: Some strips of a brown, 'barely edible', food-stuff are collecting dirt on the floor here.

Objects.Name: armour armor leather sdzone
Objects.Description: A set of leather body armour has been left in a heap.

Objects.Name: sword short sdzone
Objects.Description: A rather amateurish attempt at a short sword lies by your feet.

Objects.Name: shield sdzone
Objects.Description: The highly polished shield of a knight is starting to gather dust.

Objects.Name: sword gleaming sdzone
Objects.Description: The gleaming sword of a knight is trying to avoid the dirt.

Objects.Name: chainmail mail burnished sdzone
Objects.Description: A set of burnished chainmail has been left to rust here.

Objects.Name: shield champion champion's sdzone
Objects.Description: The King's Champion's Shield dazzles you!

Objects.Name: chainmail silvery mail sdzone
Objects.Description: A large set of silvery chainmail has been piled up here.

Objects.Name: sword gleaming sdzone
Objects.Description: The Champion's Gleaming Sword, twists with a life of its own, trying to avoid the dirt here.

Objects.Name: firestone sdzone stone
Objects.Description: A red stone, blazing with an internal fire, casts a malevolent red glow.

Objects.Name: leggings salamander sdzone
Objects.Description: A strange orange coloured material in the form of a long skirt that tapers rapidly as the feet are reached has been left here.

Objects.Name: pot chamberpot helmet sdzone
Objects.Description: A chamber pot has been abandoned here. It looks unused!

Objects.Name: post scratching sdzone
Objects.Description: A post with large green scales glued to it has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: If you could get the scales off you could make some awesome armour!

Objects.Name: sword demandred demandred's sdzone
Objects.Description: A huge sword has been left, without a scabbard, on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The single word 'Demandred' is written is large golden lettering
along the blade of this sword.

Objects.Name: gauntlets golden demandred demandred's sdzone
Objects.Description:
An amazingly intricate and strong pair gauntlets have been left 
unattended here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small tag sewn into the textile inner of each gauntlet says simply,
'Demandred'.

Objects.Name: armour armor battlearmour demandred's sdzone
Objects.Description: Someone has, rather carelessly, left his battlearmour here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you heft this armour you notice an inscription on the the breast.
'Per Ardua Ad Draconis'

Objects.Name: eye dragon mithembra's sdzone
Objects.Description: A large jewel made into a glowing eye casts shadows all around.

Objects.Name: cloak velvet black mithembra's sdzone
Objects.Description: A beautiful black velvet cloak has been thrown onto the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'Mithembra' has been neatly stitched in white cotton into the
inside of this truly beatiful cloak.

Objects.Name: dagger wicked mithembra's sdzone
Objects.Description: A wickedly sharp dagger is half hidden on the ground.

Objects.Name: glow diffuse light kamthra's sdzone
Objects.Description: A strange diffuse glowing light is coming from somewhere around here.

Objects.Name: staff golden glowing kamthra's sdzone
Objects.Description: A low level pulsating golden glow comes from a long oaken staff.

Objects.Name: gloves supple white kamthra sdzone
Objects.Description: A supple pair of lightweight white gloves are hovering just above the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
'Kamthra' is written in fine black lettering on these white, flexible,
gloves.

Objects.Name: armband metallic armbands hercules sdzone
Objects.Description: A sturdy pair of armbands with some spikes down their sides have been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A fine strand of metal has been twisted to spell the word 'Hercules'
and soldered around the edge of these heavy metallic bands.

Objects.Name: chains hercules chain iron heavy sdzone
Objects.Description: A short length of a heavy iron chain is slowly rusting on the ground.

Objects.Name: tooth dragon dragon's hercules sdzone
Objects.Description: The long and very sharp canine tooth of a dragon lies here.

Objects.Name: eye hercules sdzone
Objects.Description: What appears to be an eye levitates before you, turning this way and that way, looking for something.

Objects.Name: ring invisibility gomorra's sdzone
Objects.Description: A simple band of beaten gold has been fashioned into a ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An inscription inside the ring reads, 'This ring belons to Gomorra'.
^

Objects.Name: dragons staff sdzone
Objects.Description: An ancient looking oaken staff. It seems very powerful, you had better be careful where you point it.

Objects.Name: dagger deadly zharradan's sdzone
Objects.Description: A Black and Deadly Dagger, still dripping blood, lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you study this dagger a palpable feeling of dread fills you. A name
appears in your mind, Zharradan.......

Objects.Name: gauntlets bloodstained light mithril sdzone
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of light mithril gauntlets
Objects.Description: A pair of mithril gauntlets are oozing blood onto the floor here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Crawling red lines shift infront of you, spelling out the name of
the gauntlets' owner, 'Zharradan, High Drake of the Storm Dragons'.

Objects.Name: key golden demandred's sdzone
Objects.Description: A small golden key, stamped with the image of a dragon, lies here.

Objects.Name: key red zharradan's sdzone
Objects.Description: A blood red key, stamped with the image of a dragon, lies here.

Objects.Name: horn silvery garrion garrions sdzone
Objects.Description: A silvery horn of unusual contruction has been lovingly placed here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A maze of twisted tubes flares to a large bell. Stamped on the bell in small
letters is the name, 'Garrion'. Youput it to your lips. The sound it produces 
is shattering!

Objects.Name: lance garrion garrion's sdzone
Objects.Description: A large lance has been dropped here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A huge lance once belonging to a now deceased knight has been pressed into
service under a new owner. It's unblemished surface gleams in the light. At
the hilt a small inscription reads, 'Dragon Seeker'. Next to it in glowing
letters the legend 'Garrion, Knight Slayer' has been added.

Objects.Name: shield multicolored multicoloured lagg lagg's sdzone
Objects.Description:
A huge shield with a swirling riot of colours dancing across its surface
has been dropped here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You find it hard to focus on the shield as it ripples and dances with a
swirl of patterns and colours. You eyes start to hurt! A quick peek at 
the back tells you the owner id called Lagg.

Objects.Name: bandana headband skar skar's sdzone
Objects.Description: An innocuous strip of cloth flutters in the breeze.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Sewn into the bandana is a name tag which reads, 'Skar'

Objects.Name: sign sdzone
Objects.Description:
A Large Sign with big crude letters scrawled on it has been hammered
into the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Thar Be Dragons... --->

Objects.Name: torc dragon sdzone
Objects.Description: A gleaming torc fashioned in the shape of a dragon lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A lump of metal has been lovingly teased and pulled with great skill
and craftmanship to make this marvelous torc. The fine strands paint
a picture of a long and thin dragon with the head and tail side by
side at the front. The eyes gleam with a dull red glow.
